highlight.note: Below a tablet's width — and always, for a screen reader — the graph is a plain list.

highlight.selector: ul[aria-label='Who works on what'] > li, div[aria-label='Who works on what'] > section
highlight.note: Each card: what it is, its name (a link for people and apps), and a line for each relation, such as “works on Court booking”.
On a phone the list is grouped by kind, the first group open and the rest one tap away.
